claims.text: The resort sits on Tetiaroa, an atoll encircled by a coral reef with 12 motus, or islets.

findings.quote: Encircled by a coral reef, the atoll’s 12 motus hold back the vast blue beyond

claims.text: Guests fly into Faa'a International Airport in Papeete, Tahiti, then take Air Tetiaroa on a 20-minute scenic flight to the atoll.

findings.quote: Flights converge from across the globe at Faa’a International Airport, introducing travelers to Papeete, Tahiti, where Air Tetiaroa awaits to whisk them away on a 20-minute scenic flight to Tetiaroa.

claims.text: Marlon Brando first spied Tetiaroa on a hike in Tahiti while filming Mutiny on the Bounty in the early 1960s.

findings.quote: Marlon first spied Tetiaroa on a hike in Tahiti while filming Mutiny on the Bounty in the early 1960s.

claims.text: The resort opened in 2014, after the Brando Family Trust approved Pacific Beachcomber's plan for it in 2009.

findings.quote: That day came in 2009 when the Brando Family Trust granted approval to
Pacific Beachcomber, Richard Bailey’s company, to build the 35-villa resort that would be known as The Brando. The resort finally opened in 2014

claims.text: The private villas are spread across the Onetahi motu, set back just off the beach, alongside one private residence.

findings.quote: Spread across the Onetahi motu and set back just off the beach are 35 private villas and one private residence

claims.text: Villa doors fold open to create breezeways to the outdoors.

findings.quote: where doors fold open to create breezeways to the outdoors

claims.text: The One Bedroom Villa has an outdoor lounge area on the deck, an outdoor covered dining area and an infinity plunge pool.

findings.quote: Outdoor lounge area on deck, outdoor covered dining area, infinity plunge pool

claims.text: On the atoll, buildings are cooled with seawater, solar panels light the paths at night, and glass is returned to sand.

findings.quote: glass is returned to sand, buildings cool with seawater, and solar panels soak in the day to light paths at night

claims.text: Varua Te Ora Polynesian Spa is reached by elevated pathways that wind through tropical undergrowth to secluded spaces for relaxation and healing.

findings.quote: The entry is a portal to elevated pathways that wind through tropical undergrowth, diverging here and there like the branches of a tree, and leading to secret abodes for relaxation, meditation, contemplation, and healing.

claims.text: Fare Mana, just off the sand, hosts meditation, yoga and sound baths.

findings.quote: Just up a few steps off the sand, Fare Mana presents itself
the rituals of meditation, yoga, and sound baths are observed

claims.text: Green sea turtles nest on Tetiaroa from September to March.

findings.quote: Discover Tetiaroa’s green sea turtles nesting from September to March.

claims.text: The resort's cooking is a fusion of Polynesian flavors and classical French techniques.

findings.quote: a fusion of Polynesian flavors and classical French techniques

claims.text: During nesting season, guests can join Te Mana o Te Moana marine biologists on night patrols looking for nesting turtles or emerging hatchlings.

findings.quote: Guests can join Te Mana o Te Moana marine biologists on night patrols, moving silently in the darkness in search of females laying eggs or emerging hatchlings.
During nesting season, green turtles lay their eggs just steps away from the villas

claims.text: The Brando was the first resort globally to receive LEED Platinum Certification.

findings.quote: The Brando to become the first resort globally to receive the prestigious LEED (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design) Platinum Certification.

claims.text: Fare Manu, 'the bird house', is a treetop treatment space for two within the spa.

findings.quote: Fare Manu, “the bird house”, rises as a lofty sanctuary within the embrace of Varua Te Ora Spa.
A treetop haven for two

claims.text: Reef Quest is a snorkeling trip to coral gardens on the outer barrier reef, for confident swimmers aged 12 and up.

findings.quote: commencing a snorkeling adventure amid vibrant coral gardens
The tour vessel is steered towards the outer limits, the barrier reef that stands as the atoll’s custodian.

### Minimum age 12 years old

Must be a confident swimmer

claims.text: Bob's Bar is Marlon Brando's original beachside bar, serving the signature 'Bob's Last Drop' cocktail.

findings.quote: Beachside food and drink in Marlon Brando’s original bar
savor a signature cocktail, the ‘Bob’s Last Drop,’

claims.text: Getting there takes a second flight: after landing in Papeete, Tahiti, guests take Air Tetiaroa on a 20-minute flight to the atoll.

findings.quote: Flights converge from across the globe at Faa’a International Airport, introducing travelers to Papeete, Tahiti, where Air Tetiaroa awaits to whisk them away on a 20-minute scenic flight to Tetiaroa.

claims.text: Turtle nesting runs from September to March, so the night patrols are seasonal.

findings.quote: Discover Tetiaroa’s green sea turtles nesting from September to March.
For more than 20 years, the Te Mana o Te Moana association has patrolled these beaches night after night during nesting season

claims.text: WhataHotel notes ultra-premium pricing that reflects the resort's exclusivity.
